statements.statement: The patient has a history of nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The patient reports intermittent dizziness and giddiness
The service was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias
The service was ordered to assess the hemodynamic impact of the valvular disease
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-197
The denial reason is that required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered
